skill.name: 唐诗宋词元曲查询 - 即刻数据

instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
唐诗宋词元曲查询。支持古诗词列表、详情、诗人查询、诗人详情、随机诗词、词牌信息、朝代列表、类别列表和体裁列表。适用场景：用户说“查相思这首诗”“杜甫简介”“随机来一首宋词”“水调歌头词牌是什么”等。数据由即刻数据（jikeapi.cn）开放接口提供。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of jike-poetry-query skill.
- Supports searching and retrieving details for Tang poetry, Song lyrics, and Yuan songs.
- Features include poem and poet lookup, random poem selection, querying poetic forms, dynasties, categories, and genres.
- Uses data provided by jikeapi.cn via open API.
- Requires configuration of JIKE_POETRY_QUERY_KEY or JIKE_APPKEY environment variable.
